newsitem.title: USA: DQE takes H Power stake, orders fuel cells.
newsitem.headline: DQE takes H Power stake, orders fuel cells.

text.p: DQE Inc said Friday its Duquesne Enterprises Inc subsidiary has made an undisclosed investment in H Power Corp, a fuel cell development company.

DQE also said its subsidiary placed an order with H Power for the purchase of two residential fuel cell systems for delivery in 1997. These units are capable of providing all of the electricity needs of a single or multi-family home. Duquesne Enterprises believes that it is the first company in the world to purchase a residential fuel cell system, DQE said.
It said Duquesne Enterprises will be immediately represented on H Power's board.
